title: Internal: handling procedure for closing out a combined-clock container record with goodwill and a card payment
content:
## Situation

This procedure of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category applies to a per-container free-time record that runs a combined clock, whose last clock has stopped, that has not yet been invoiced, and whose merged clock carries chargeable days both inside and outside the terminal, when the billed party asks in the same call for a goodwill reduction on the demurrage and wants to pay the record off at once by card.

When the procedure is complete, the record carries its final detention and demurrage lines, one commercial goodwill waiver on the demurrage line and one card payment equal to the balance then due, and it is settled with nothing owed.

## Steps

1. **Agent**: book the final detention line of the combined clock with book_detention_invoice_dba94f21.
2. **Agent**: book the final demurrage line, continuing the slab count, with book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7.
3. **Agent**: grant the goodwill on the demurrage line with grant_goodwill_waiver_e03c98b1.
4. **Customer themselves**: the billed party pays the balance by card with pay_dnd_balance_a831ef2f.
5. **Agent**: settle the record at zero balance with settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba.

## Who performs each step

| Step | Performed by | Business action |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | agent | final detention line of the combined clock |
| 2 | agent | final demurrage line continuing the slab count |
| 3 | agent | commercial goodwill on the demurrage line |
| 4 | the customer themselves | card payment of the balance |
| 5 | agent | settlement at zero balance |

## What passes from step to step

The invoice reference returned when the demurrage line is booked in step 2 is the invoice line the goodwill waiver of step 3 refers to. The goodwill request window and the limit of one goodwill waiver per line are judged on that same line.

## Why the steps run in this order

- **Detention before demurrage.** On a combined record the demurrage slab count continues after the chargeable days of the detention line already booked; booked the other way round, the demurrage days would restart at slab 1 and carry the wrong rates.
- **Demurrage before goodwill.** Goodwill on demurrage is computed only on a demurrage line that already exists on the record and refers to it; before it exists there is no line to waive and no open amount, and the goodwill window runs from that line's date.
- **Goodwill before the card payment.** A payment may not exceed the record's balance due, and the balance the billed party can pay in full is known only once the goodwill is off; paid first, the later goodwill would leave the record in credit.
- **Card payment before settlement.** A record is settled only when its balance reaches 0.00 through payments, waivers and credits; settled earlier, it would close with money still owed.

Every step is a synchronous booking at the desk or the billed party's own card payment made in the call; none of them waits for an outside event or for time to pass.

## What goes wrong if two neighbouring steps are swapped

| Swap | Consequence |
|---|---|
| Demurrage line booked before detention line | demurrage days restart at slab 1 and are billed at the wrong rates |
| Goodwill before the demurrage line | no demurrage line to waive and no open amount |
| Card payment before goodwill | the later goodwill leaves the record in credit |
| Settlement before the card payment | the record closes with money still owed |
